detail.title: Refining Mechanisms of Musical Valence: Reward and Prediction Error
detail.summary: We are deepening the investigation into the emotional dimensions of predictive musical processing by specifically targeting the neurobiological reward mechanisms that bridge prediction error and the aesthetic experience of tension and resolution. While our current synthesis identifies a general link between predictive error minimization and emotional response, the specific neural architecture (such as dopaminergic activity) remains a critical gap for a nuanced explanation.
